info.name: SPX Graphics Control Data Files API

params.name: folder
params.description: Subfolder path relative to the ASSETS directory

params.name: apikey
params.description: API key for authentication. Required only if the SPX configuration has an apikey value set. Leave empty if no restriction is configured.

items.docs: Returns a list of files from a given subfolder within the ASSETS folder of the SPX installation. Useful for populating template dropdowns or media selection UIs.
